evidence_class: Scoped fixture launch grants from LaunchAuthority, fakeredis, fixture clock and frozen datetime; no live rollout. Live G3 qualification is separate.
interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.registry.FleetRegistry.register: grant-only registration; the seat comes from the validated launch grant, never the name; record and seat generations fenced; identical replay writes nothing; a closed record is never revived
FleetRegistry.heartbeat and close: require the record's own grant; a superseded or concurrently replaced record raises stale_generation
FleetRegistry.observe: judges only records of its own scope (backend, host, process namespace), only moves live to suspect, and judges nothing on an empty table
FleetRegistry.sweep: moves silent live records to suspect; nothing deletes records
FleetRegistry.visible: local records only while distributed launches are disabled (the rollback read)
FleetRegistry.find, seat, records, fleet_registry_stale_records; registry.session_key, encode, decode

hooks.context.broadcast: register_session stamps process_namespace; foreign_session; the heartbeat probes only local PIDs, revives the owner's suspect records, suspects silent foreign records after 300 s and still prunes at 24 h; get_active_sessions cleanup skips foreign records
scripts.terminate_agent.sessions: a record from another process namespace never claims a local PID

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards passed in the linked CI run
supported_versions.coordination: SV2-CTL launch grants (LaunchAuthority registration), execution generations and the NameRegistry alias records
supported_versions.persistence: swarm export and restore carry the fleet-sessions and fleet-seats hashes and the alias keys
supported_versions.compatibility: Unstamped session records stay local, so the existing local swarm keeps its behaviour (INV-R11)

states.observed: Process tables of the owning scope and owner heartbeats; observations only suspect a record
states.accepted: Grant-validated registration at the current execution generation
states.committed: Redis WATCH/MULTI transaction on the fleet-sessions and fleet-seats hashes
states.externally_verified: None; no production writer and no live rollout yet

measurements.dimension: Each test has its own fakeredis swarm built from fleet-registry.json; a counts the anton record suspected by its own process table

rollback_rehearsal.action: Read the registry through FleetRegistry.visible with distributed launches disabled (AGENTIHOOKS_RUNTIME_DISABLED names the remote backend, or the runtime backend is local)
rollback_rehearsal.data_safety: Remote records stay stored untouched; rows are byte-equal before and after; the registry and session records are authoritative and never deleted as caches

remaining_limitations: No production writer of the Redis registry exists yet; wiring it into the controller launch path belongs to the runtime and accounting packages (SV2-ACC-02 depends on this package)
A record whose process died without closing stays suspect until the controller path ends it
The default registry clock is the caller's host wall clock; the controller must inject its clock
The broadcast foreign-suspect window compares the owner's last_seen with the observer's clock; skew beyond 300 s misjudges it
active-sessions.json is assumed per host; unstamped legacy records are treated as local
find is a name lookup, not a rollback read
